T: Some lessons aren't taught at film school.
D: A film student gets a job with a man who looks a lot like Vito Corleone.
P: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.
S: Carmine's social club, where the job offer comes with a handshake
Salami, mortadella and provolone with roasted capsicum, marinated artichokes and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn at the table.
Carmine's Little Italy, where every deal starts at the table

Steamed clams on the half shell under garlic, oregano, parmesan and lemon breadcrumbs, grilled until crisp and bubbling. Purge 1kg vongole in cold salted water for 30 minutes, then steam in a covered pan with 100ml white wine for 3 to 4 minutes until open. Discard any that stay shut and remove top shells. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley, lemon zest and 3 tbsp olive oil. Press onto each clam. Grill on high for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon wedges.
Tender squid rings in a light crisp coating, with lemon and marinara. Slice 500g squid tubes into rings, soak in 200ml milk for 20 minutes and toss in 120g flour mixed with 2 tbsp semolina and salt.
M: the family dinner where Clark gets told how things work
Thin veal floured and seared in butter, pan sauce of marsala, mushrooms and stock reduced and finished with cold butter.
roast chicken, nothing endangered on this menu
Dry-brine a chicken overnight, butter and lemon under the skin, roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C until 72C in the thigh. Rest 15 minutes, roast potatoes in the fat.
W: a box from Little Italy for the drive back to campus
Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into shells just before serving, pistachio ends.
K: Carmine's table, where the glasses never stay empty

Italian amaro and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda and a slice of orange, bittersweet and easy to drink. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Add 50ml Italian amaro to each glass, then 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently. Cut 1 orange into thin wheels and slide one into each glass. Serve straight away while the bubbles are lively.

edition.cue: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.

s.note: Carmine's social club, where the job offer comes with a handshake
s.how: Arrange 100g salami, 100g mortadella and 150g provolone on a board. Add 2 roasted red capsicums cut into strips and 200g marinated artichokes. Tear a loaf of seeded Italian bread at the table.
Slice 500g squid tubes into rings, soak in 200ml milk for 20 minutes and toss in 120g flour mixed with 2 tbsp semolina and salt. Fry at 190C for 1 minute and serve with lemon and 250g marinara.

m.note: the family dinner where Clark gets told how things work
m.how: Dust 600g veal escalopes with seasoned flour and sear in 20g butter and a little oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside. Brown 250g sliced button mushrooms in the pan, add 150ml marsala and 150ml beef stock and reduce by half. Whisk in 40g cold butter, return the veal and warm through.

w.note: a box from Little Italy for the drive back to campus
w.how: Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract and 50g mini choc chips. Pipe into 8 cannoli shells just before serving and dip the ends in 30g chopped pistachios.

d.note: Italian amaro and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda and a slice of orange, bittersweet and easy to drink.
d.how: Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Add 50ml Italian amaro to each glass, then 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently. Cut 1 orange into thin wheels and slide one into each glass. Serve straight away while the bubbles are lively.
